what: Predicted size of the move from today's 09:30 open to the next session's 09:30 open, |open->next open|, ranked within the top 1,000 names by 20-day dollar volume (actual prior close >= $5). rank 1.00 = largest expected move.
inputs: bars dated before the day only (no same-day open), SPY/VIX closes before the day, Nasdaq earnings calendar
backfill: 2020-01-02..2026-10-02: walk-forward out-of-sample predictions only (each window predicted by a model trained on earlier dates). 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-06 are not scored. From 2026-10-07: forward days frozen before 09:25 ET, append-only, locked (days/*.json + LOCKS.jsonl).
baseline_note: Beats plain 20-day Parkinson volatility only slightly: mean daily rank IC vs realized |open->next open| about 0.42 vs 0.38 (2025-01..2026-07 confirm window).
format: y/YYYY.bin.gz = gzip of little-endian: char[4] "EM01", u16 nT, u16 nD, u16 tickerIdx[nT], u16 dayIdx[nD], u16 rank[nD][nT] (model rank pct*10000), u16 park20rank[nD][nT] (20-day Parkinson vol rank pct*10000), u16 absmove[nD][nT] (realized |open->next open| in bp); 65535 = missing
